Distribution (Fig. 184) and biology. Aulacophora cornuta is a widespread species from India east to the Solomon Islands, including Timor (Barroga & Mohamedsaid 2002). However recent surveys of Timor by Australian biosecurity entomologists and the Australian Museum have failed to find this species. It is unrecorded from Australia but is a potentially invasive species. There are no recorded hosts for A. cornuta except pumpkin (Kimoto et al. 1984) and unspecified Cucurbitaceae (Reid 1998).
